instruction: Clean up a podium facade model from the provided IFC. Open C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc in Revit and use C:\Users\user\Desktop\init_sheet.png as the visual reference for the starting condition. Clean up the podium facade scheme, then export the IFC4 model to C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc and a one-page Revit elevation sheet to C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.pdf. The IFC must contain one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, one IfcBuildingStorey, four IfcWall elements, one IfcSlab, and five IfcCurtainWall elements. The final IFC should not include IfcSpace, IfcRoof, IfcDoor, IfcWindow, IfcStair, IfcColumn, IfcBeam, or IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. The PDF must be a single-page sheet whose visible text includes PODIUM FACADE and A301. The init model should be used as the starting facade condition rather than submitted unchanged. Other sheet graphics and facade detailing may vary, but all IfcRoot GlobalIds must be unique. [Software] Launch Revit with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe`.
